description: Search published TanStarter documentation and return ranked public pages. Each result has a title, path, canonical URL such as https://docs.tanstarter.dev/ai, a short excerpt, and locale. Read-only. No authentication. Searches English (en) or Chinese (zh) docs only, never source code, accounts, or private data.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

locale.description: Documentation language. English is the default.

query.description: Text to match against published documentation.

name: search_docs
